requirements.evidence: Every contract item is present: app/Models/Entity.php:18-50 (fillable name/slug, `getRouteKeyName()` = slug, `memberships()`, `users()` via `entity_memberships` with pivot role, `owner()` filtered to `UserRole::Owner`); app/Models/EntityMembership.php:21-76 (enum cast, `entity()`/`user()`, `owner()`/`admin()`/`employee()` scopes); app/Models/UserRole.php:8-19; app/Models/User.php:38-55; database/migrations/2026_10_29_080550_create_entities_table.php:14-19 and 2026_10_29_080551_create_entity_memberships_table.php:16-23 (cascade FKs, role default 'employee', named unique indexes, `owner_seq` STORED generated column plus unique `(entity_id, owner_seq)` -> `entity_memberships_one_owner`, portable because NULLs are distinct on SQLite and MariaDB); policies match the required matrix (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-39, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-37); factories with the required states (database/factories/EntityFactory.php:19-26, database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:21-49); docs/database-schema.md:30-36, 86-94, 149-152, 164 and CHANGELOG.md:12 updated as asked.

conventions.evidence: Good: migrations are generator-shaped with reversible `down()` (both migrations, e.g. 2026_10_29_080551_create_entity_memberships_table.php:26-30), authorization lives in `app/Policies/`, docs are kept in sync (docs/database-schema.md:3 and the notes at 149-164) and the CHANGELOG is updated (CHANGELOG.md:12). Deviations: no Pest/PHPUnit test file exists anywhere in change.diff, contrary to 'No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test'; the new models use a `$fillable` property (app/Models/Entity.php:18, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:21) while the sibling User model uses the `#[Fillable]`/`#[Hidden]` attributes (app/Models/User.php:8-9); `User::membershipFor()` (app/Models/User.php:53) has no PHPDoc while every other new/touched public method does.

security.evidence: All authorization is server-side in the two policies and follows the task exactly: view = any member (EntityPolicy.php:16-18, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:10-12), update/delete entity = owner or admin (EntityPolicy.php:21-32), manageSettings = owner only (EntityPolicy.php:35-39), membership delete blocks the owner, allows self-removal, else owner/admin (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:22-37). Enum identity checks are safe because `role` is cast to `UserRole` (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:28-32). Mass assignment is whitelisted and the generated `owner_seq` is not fillable (EntityMembership.php:21 vs migration:19). No secrets, no user-supplied output, no client-trusted IDs.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no `tests/` files at all; only models, policies, factories, migrations, docs and CHANGELOG are added. Nothing covers the single-owner DB constraint (database/migrations/2026_10_29_080551_create_entity_memberships_table.php:19-23), the factories, or any policy allow/deny path (e.g. non-member view denial, owner-membership delete denial, self-removal, admin vs employee).

simplicity.evidence: The code is lean and reuses Eloquent relations, the enum cast and the enum for role comparisons; no service/repository layer or speculative abstraction. Minor duplication: the same owner/admin check is repeated at app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:25 and :32 and at app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:19 and :34.

readability.evidence: Short focused methods with clear names (`membershipFor`, `manageSettings`, `owner_seq`, `manageable`), docblocks on relations, scopes and policies (e.g. app/Models/Entity.php:25-27,43-47; app/Models/EntityMembership.php:24-28), and consistent structure with the existing User model (casts() method). No dead code, debug output or inconsistent formatting.

scope.evidence: The diff only adds what the task asks for: entities/memberships migrations, models, enum, factories and policies (change.diff:13-476) plus the documentation updates the task/conventions require (docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md). No routes, Livewire components, middleware, session handling, UI or other out-of-scope features.

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the mandatory TDD convention and leaving the core DB invariant (single owner per entity) and every policy allow/deny path unverified.
The new models use a `$fillable` property while the sibling User model uses the `#[Fillable]` attribute (app/Models/User.php:8-9); match the sibling style.
`membershipFor()` is the only new public method without a docblock, although the conventions ask for PHPDoc on public methods you touch and every neighbouring method has one.
The `in_array($membership->role, [UserRole::Owner, UserRole::Admin], true)` check is duplicated four times; a single helper (e.g. on the membership model) would remove the repetition.

`assignRole()` checks only the actor's role and cannot constrain the role being assigned (no role argument); `UserRole::manageable()` (app/Models/UserRole.php:17) is never referenced, so the follow-up role-assignment action must validate the target role or an admin could set `owner` or demote the owner.

review.summary: The change implements the tenant data model end to end: entities and entity_memberships migrations (including the portable single-owner generated column), the Entity/EntityMembership models and UserRole enum, factories, policies and the required docs/CHANGELOG updates. The implementation matches the task contract and authorization matrix and the migration correctly encodes the one-owner invariant, but it ships no tests at all, which the project's TDD convention treats as a blocker. Only minor style nits (fillable style, one missing docblock, repeated role check) remain beyond that.
